title: Mathematics Marks Difference
description: Two students scored different marks in a mathematics test. Create a workflow that calculates the difference between their marks.

title: Stationery Shop Total
description: A student buys a notebook, pen, and pencil from a stationery shop. Calculate the total cost of all the items.

title: Three-Test Average
description: A teacher wants to calculate the average marks of a student across three tests.

title: School Bag Discount
description: A shop offers a discount on a school bag. Calculate the discount amount and final price.
operation: Discount = price × rate; final price = price - discount

title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
description: A weather station records temperature in Celsius, but the display requires Fahrenheit.

title: Swap Locker Numbers
description: Two students are assigned the wrong locker numbers. Create a workflow that swaps Student A and Student B's locker numbers.
expected_output:
Student A locker = 25
Student B locker = 12

title: Leap Year Checker
description: Check whether a given year is a leap year. A leap year is divisible by 4, except century years must also be divisible by 400.

title: School Supplies Budget
description: Calculate the total bill and check whether the student can afford it.

title: Continent Position
description: Display the position of a continent using a simplified coordinate grid. Asia is in the Northern and Eastern hemispheres, in the upper-right region.
operation: Look up hemisphere and globe position
expected_output:
Continent: Asia
Hemisphere: Northern and Eastern
Position: Upper-right region of the simplified globe

title: Traffic Light Instruction
description: Given a traffic light color, display the appropriate instruction. Red means Stop, Yellow means Wait, and Green means Go.
